text:
alex: FYI vendor (OrionCloud) just pinged — ETA slip on 3 racks, asking if we can (a) shorten their insurance hold (b) bump their reserved capacity window by 10 days while they expedite. they want an answer today.

maria: which reservation IDs? how big is the risk to our committed customers?

alex: reservation IDs: RSRV-9442, RSRV-9443, RSRV-9444. affected commit = 2 enterprise Dedicated pools (total 3 racks). customers on those pools are low-traffic for next week but will hit ramp in 10 days.

samir: short answer: we can absorb 1 week without impacting running SLAs, +10 days starts to force degrade for some routes. we need freight proof or a prepay.

jen: legal can't sign off on removing insurance obligation. contract calls out insurance requirement in SLA 4.2b. we need written partner confirmation that insurance stays in place.

alex: copying the partner now — @orion-partner can you confirm insurance coverage remains? also can you confirm whether you can prepay expedited freight?

orion-partner: sorry for the panic — port hold cleared but manifests delayed. we cannot waive insurance (we have it) and we can prepay expedited freight for 2 of 3 racks. can you provide a 7-day grace rather than 10? we can push earlier ETD for last rack.

liz: ops note — if we agree to 7 days, we can pull from the marketplace spare pool and spin up a short-lived buffer in SFO-3 DC. needs 12h lead time to route.

ben: finance — cost delta if we cover expedited freight: ~+$8k (net). if partner prepays 50% we can eat the rest and invoice them for the delta afterwards. need OK from sales on pass-through.

maria: proposal: offer 7-day grace, require partner keep insurance, partner prepays 50% expedited freight within 24h, we allocate 1 rack from marketplace buffer to cover peak. legal to ack.

samir: agreed from ops, but add explicit fallback: if manifest not shipped by day 7 we trigger auto-fallback to model-variant routing and throttle those customer routes. I'll add a runbook step.

jen: legal: ok to proceed with 7-day grace if we get written confirmation of insurance + prepay terms. send contract snippet into thread and I'll draft amendment.

alex: sending sample amendment we can send to partner:

```
Amendment: Redwood agrees to a one-time 7-day capacity grace for reservations RSRV-9442/43/44 contingent on: (1) partner maintains full cargo insurance; (2) partner prepays 50% of expedited freight costs within 24 hours of this agreement; (3) partner provides revised ETD no later than 72 hours. Failure triggers automatic capacity fallback and invoice for any incurred costs.
```

orion-partner: confirmed — we will send written insurance confirmation and prepay 50% within 12h. updated ETD for rack 3 provided: +5 days. appreciate the flexibility.

ops-bot: action created: PARTNERS-3641 — provision buffer rack in SFO-3, update reservations, notify customers. owner: samir. ETA: 12h.

alex: great — next steps: jen draft amendment, ben issue invoice link, samir ops executes buffer placement, maria update marketplace listing for reserved capacity note. i'll follow up with partner comms. :thumbsup:
